component: Fence original native-offer cleanup before candidate ownership transfer
problem: settle_native_offer_cleanup used generation>=the original lease and ignored whether its projection UPDATE matched. An old attributed absence could retire a later generation sharing the public Connection ID, or mutate old operation/effect metadata and journal a retirement after no matching projection update.
change: Require the exact lease generation and either an unobserved original projection or the matching installation runtime. Require exactly one projection update; refusal rolls the whole transaction back. An already-retired original remains idempotent. No candidate readiness or replacement ticket is inferred from this check.

sql.scope: Extracted production SQL generation/runtime compare-and-swap and SQLite transaction rollback only; no Rust compilation, original engine cleanup or candidate adoption qualification.

verification.rust_regression_scope: Three controlled projection races cover generations2/17 and foreign runtime, whole old-operation/effect/projection/journal rollback, then valid exact cleanup and repeated idempotent cleanup. No actual engine readiness or candidate adoption is simulated as a pass.
verification.rust_compile_runtime: Pending original Linux execution; no local Rust build due disk capacity. A required isolated Store fixture lane was added.

remaining: Implement explicit current-authority custody of the selected pending native attempt, preserving original attempt uncertainty and attribution.
Retire and join its old Core/native worker, acquire a fresh replacement ticket/resources/runtime identity, and compare-and-swap the existing domain projection to its new generation.
Preserve immutable historical mapping for old cleanup/status while preventing old grants or cleanup from reaching the adopted successor.
Keep source/retained media and current Endpoint/Device/member epoch/credential checks, stable logical mutation IDs, strict audio and original request/phase budgets.
